facts_raw.Funding Trigger: Rockstart fund investment decision; accelerator/support follows portfolio admission
facts_raw.Capital Disclosure Status: Verified — Investment Model Public / Standard Check Not Public
facts_raw.Official / Must-Have Requirements: Early-stage startup aligned to the specific Rockstart domain; Rockstart invests from pre-seed and can follow through Series B.
facts_raw.Strong-to-Have: 全职创始团队；清晰 founder-market fit；可演示产品/MVP；真实用户/客户验证；明确下一阶段里程碑与融资用途。

facts_raw.Public Contact Route: 官方申请入口优先；若官网未公开联系人，不建议猜测个人联系方式。

facts_raw.Foundshore Not Fit: 只有想法、无 MVP/traction 的极早期项目
facts_raw.Notes: Rockstart AgriFood portfolio companies receive accelerator/fast-track scaling support; historical fund disclosure describes a 20-week accelerator for initial investments.

facts.Funding Trigger: Rockstart fund investment decision; accelerator/support follows portfolio admission
facts.Capital Disclosure Status: Verified — Investment Model Public / Standard Check Not Public
facts.Official / Must-Have Requirements: Early-stage startup aligned to the specific Rockstart domain; Rockstart invests from pre-seed and can follow through Series B.
facts.Strong-to-Have: Full-time founders, clear founder-market fit, a demonstrable MVP, customer validation and explicit milestones and funding needs.
facts.On-site / Attendance: No standard attendance requirement published. Confirm the current cohort arrangements for Europe.
facts.Visa / Relocation: No standard visa support published; participants must independently confirm lawful entry and stay for US or European activities.
facts.Application Materials: Team, company, product, market, traction and funding information; consult the current official application form.
facts.Public Contact Route: Use the official application. Do not infer private contact information when none is published.
facts.Foundshore Best Fit: High-growth technology startups; primarily at the Seed–growth stage.
facts.Foundshore Not Fit: Idea-only projects without an MVP or traction
facts.Notes: Rockstart AgriFood portfolio companies receive accelerator/fast-track scaling support; historical fund disclosure describes a 20-week accelerator for initial investments.
